description: This file implements a ContactsHandler class for managing contacts on Android devices, including searching and adding contacts, with permission checks and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact with identifier, display name, name components, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class for search query parameters including optional query string and limit.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Data class for adding a contact, including optional name, organization, and lists of phone numbers and emails.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for contact permission checks, search, and add operations.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of ContactsDataSource for Android's contacts provider, handling permission checks, search, and add contact functionalities.

classes.name: ContactsHandler
classes.description: Main class managing contact search and addition, handling JSON requests, permission validation, and invoking data source methods.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read contacts.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to write contacts.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for contacts matching the query, returning a list of ContactRecord.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact based on the provided request, returning the created ContactRecord.

methods.name: loadContactRecord
methods.description: Loads detailed contact information from the contacts provider for a given contact ID.

methods.name: loadNameRow
methods.description: Retrieves name components for a contact.

methods.name: loadOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves organization name for a contact.

methods.name: loadPhones
methods.description: Retrieves phone numbers for a contact.

methods.name: loadEmails
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses for a contact.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a ContactsSearchRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a ContactsAddRequest object.

methods.name: contactJson
methods.description: Converts a ContactRecord into a JSON object for output.
